lines: [TBD] Captain! Come to hear a song? I know three. Well, two and a half.
[TBD] Don't look at me like that. No guard, no cell. A free man can sing if he wants to.

options.text: [TBD] Keep it down. People are trying to sleep.
reply: [TBD] Sleep? On this wreck? Nobody's sleeping, Captain. They're just lying still and counting the Food.

options.text: [TBD] What were you locked up for?
reply: [TBD] Ha. Ask me again when we're down to the last ration bar. Then you'll really want to know.
[TBD] Suit yourself. The half-song's the best one anyway.

lines: [TBD] The freezer airlock's sealed tight. I checked it twice this morning. Three times, maybe.

options.text: [TBD] You saved us when you sealed it.
reply: [TBD] Daniel was still on the other side. Don't call it saving.
[TBD] If I close my eyes I hear the fire. Give me something to fix instead.

lines: [TBD] It's Dr. Voss. I saw you hesitate.
[TBD] If you're here about the compost bin, my answer hasn't changed.

options.text: [TBD] We may not have a choice about the food.
reply: [TBD] There is always a choice. It's usually between dying slowly and dying slightly less slowly.
[TBD] Physically? Fine. Mentally, Mason is singing and Elias stopped blinking. Draw your own conclusions.

options.text: [TBD] Sorry to bother you, Dr. Voss.

lines: [TBD] Oh! Captain. I was just sorting what's left.
[TBD] It looks worse than it is. Mostly. I can stretch it, I promise. Not a single crumb wasted.

options.text: [TBD] How long can the Food last?
reply: [TBD] Depends how many mouths there are to feed. I'd rather not do that math out loud.
[TBD] Safe enough, if it's cooked hot. Please don't tell Dr. Voss I said that.
[TBD] Thank me when there's still dinner on Day 30.

lines: [TBD] Hey, Captain. Pull up some floor. It's the comfiest floor on the ship.
[TBD] Don't worry about me. I don't need much. Just a little something to rinse with now and then.

options.text: [TBD] Where did you even come from?
reply: [TBD] Out there. Drifting. You know how it is. Then I heard your airlock was friendly.

options.text: [TBD] Are you going to help out around here?
reply: [TBD] Help? I'm keeping morale up. Look at me. Do I look worried? That's leadership.
